newsitem.title: UK: Barclays trails sector as sentiment hurt.
newsitem.headline: Barclays trails sector as sentiment hurt.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc were higher on Friday but relatively weak against the sector as gains were capped on a raft on negative news.
The shares were up 9p at 12.48 stg by 0915 GMT after starting the session 20p lower on the day.
Sentiment was dented by news of a strike ballot and rumours of potentially massive derivatives losses for investment arm BZW. Traders cited fading bid hopes as another negative for the shares.
In the U.S. overnight, renewed speculation that Citicorp may bid for American Express dampened hopes that Citicorp could launch a bid for BZW.
"Amex was a very strong market in the States on thoughts that Citicorp was poised to bid," said one senior dealer. "That makes a bid for BZW look a lot less likely."
Press reports that BZW could be among those worst affected by derivatives losses on the back of the abolition of tax exemption on dividends, was also affecting sentiment.
"It's all around the press about BZW being involved in these massive losses," the trader said.
Separately, news last night of a strike ballot to be conducted by unions on Monday was capping gains.
The two unions involved, UNiFI and BIFU represent more than three quarters of Barclays staff.
